BL-1914 — When the merge path cannot merge origin/main into a line, its LAND_PATH decline gives git's own reason (the conflicted paths, or the refusing hook's first line) instead of calling every failure a conflict
What it solves: ## What is wrong
Approval context: Defect found by the specifier's BL-1870 merge-path census. No choice is posed. FIRM - the decline and its fallback to the land step do not change; only the reason the LAND_PATH line gives.
BL-1914 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-1914" (or "reject BL-1914 <reason>") to act.
